sentences.japanese: 君の意見を押しつけないでくれ。
sentences.english: Don't press your opinions on me.

sentences.japanese: 君にそれをやる気があるならあと押ししよう。
sentences.english: I'll stand behind you if you are going to do it.

sentences.japanese: 緊急の場合は、このボタンを押しなさい。
sentences.english: In case of an emergency, push this button.

sentences.japanese: その橋は洪水で押し流されてしまった。
sentences.english: The bridge was carried away by the flood.

sentences.japanese: 強盗はその子供を押し入れに閉じ込めた。
sentences.english: The burglar shut the child in the closet.
